# GitHub Configuration & Open Source Automation (`.github/`)

## Purpose
The `.github` directory contains community templates, governance policies, and CI/CD workflow automation specifications for GitHub.

## Responsibility
- Host GitHub issue and pull request templates to streamline community contributions.
- Store GitHub Actions workflow pipeline declarations for continuous integration, testing, and deployment.

## Subdirectory Structure
- **`workflows/`**: CI/CD pipeline automation workflows (build, test, lint, release).
- **`ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`**: Standardized bug report and feature request forms.

## What Belongs Here
- GitHub configuration files, template markdown files, and workflow YAML definitions.

## What Does NOT Belong Here
- Application source code or business logic.

## Future Roadmap
- Continuous Integration pipeline workflow for running backend pytest and frontend linter.
- Automated release notes generator workflow.
